metaDescription: Order custom full color magnets for your business. Perfect for promotions, schedules, and more. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Full color magnets let you reproduce logos, photos, and detailed artwork with crisp, vibrant results. Unlike single-color or spot-color options, full color printing captures gradients and fine details, making these magnets ideal for promotional giveaways, realtor magnets, or branded calendars. Choose from shapes like circles, squares, or rectangles, and sizes from business card to 4x6 inches. Custom full color magnets offer a practical, high-impact way to keep your brand visible on refrigerators, file cabinets, and metal surfaces.
heroAltText: Assorted custom full color magnets featuring logos and designs on various shapes and sizes
